t: There is no church here now. This was the site of St Thomas Charterhouse, a Church of England church built in 1842. Its architect was Edward Blore, who also designed Buckingham Palace. The church closed in 1906 and was demolished in 1909, so what you see today is a later London built over it. Blore was an architect, artist and antiquary, and this was one of his many commissions.
